nodes.label: Mobile App Router
nodes.description: Root layout: mounts provider tree (ErrorBoundary → QueryClient → GestureHandler → Keyboard → Theme → Auth → Purchase → Sync) and Stack navigator

nodes.label: Tab Navigator
nodes.description: Custom floating pill-shaped tab bar with 3 tabs: Learn, Stats, Profile. Uses CustomTabBar component

nodes.label: Auth UI
nodes.description: Login screen (email/password + Google OAuth) and auth callback handler. Uses useAuthForm hook

nodes.label: Learn UI
nodes.description: Content browsing: LearnScreen → YearScreen → ModuleScreen → SubjectScreen. Includes offline download (useSubjectCache), progress badges, best score stars, and mastery filter

nodes.label: Quiz UI
nodes.description: Active quiz session: question display with images, animated progress bar, option selection with haptics, results view with ScoreRing, and full review screen

nodes.label: Stats UI
nodes.description: Dashboard: StreakCard, StatsMetricsGrid (4 stat pill cards), WeeklyChart, MasterySection with filter chips, RecentResultsSection. Navigates to MasteryScreen for detailed view

nodes.label: Purchase UI
nodes.description: Paywall modal: TabSwitcher (Buy/Code tabs), BuyTab with RevenueCat packages, CodeTab for promo codes, restore purchase, SuccessState. Presented as modal from learn flow

nodes.label: Profile UI
nodes.description: ProfileScreen (avatar, name, theme selector, feedback form, account actions), EditProfileScreen (avatar picker with DoctorAvatars, display name editing)

nodes.label: Error Boundary
nodes.description: Catches unhandled component errors app-wide, renders ErrorFallback

nodes.label: Offline Banner
nodes.description: Animated banner that shows offline/syncing status. Exported from shared components but not currently rendered in any screen

nodes.label: Feedback Form
nodes.description: Self-contained feedback submission component with cooldown timer, character limit (500), input sanitization, and haptic feedback. Rendered inside ProfileScreen

nodes.label: Auth Store
nodes.description: Manages user session: signIn (email), signUp, signInWithGoogle (via expo-web-browser OAuth), signOut. AuthProvider listens to onAuthStateChange and deep links. Clears cacheStore, progressService memCache, and bestScoreService memCache on sign-out

nodes.label: Sync Engine
nodes.description: Tracks isOnline, isSyncing, pendingCount. SyncProvider subscribes to NetInfo for connectivity. useSyncActions provides flush() which drains offline queue to Supabase with 10s timeouts and 30s backoff, then invalidates stats/progress queries

nodes.label: Purchase Store
nodes.description: Manages IAP: purchaseModule (RevenueCat SDK → record-iap edge function), redeemCode (Supabase RPC redeem_access_code), restorePurchases, restoreModule. PurchaseProvider initializes RevenueCat and syncs user identity

nodes.label: Cache Store
nodes.description: In-memory Zustand store for: statsCache (Map<userId, UserStats>), warmedStats (Set<userId>), questionCacheBypassed flag. No API calls — purely a synchronous cache layer

nodes.label: Theme Store
nodes.description: Manages theme preference: 'harvi' (warm beige) or 'pink'. ThemeProvider loads saved theme from AsyncStorage on mount. Sets Appearance.setColorScheme('light') for both themes

nodes.label: React Query Client
nodes.description: Global QueryClient with offlineFirst networkMode, 24h gcTime, retry: 1. Provides data caching layer for all features: hierarchy, progress, bestScores, stats, quiz, content_access, my_purchases. Supports query invalidation for cross-feature reactivity

nodes.label: Hierarchy Service
nodes.description: Fetches Year→Module→Subject→Lecture tree from 4 Supabase tables (years, modules, subjects, lectures) with FK auto-detection. Offline-first: caches full hierarchy to AsyncStorage, serves cache when offline

nodes.label: Access Service
nodes.description: Fetches content access map via Supabase RPC get_content_access_map. Returns Map<itemId, ContentAccessEntry> with has_access, is_free, price_cents. Caches to AsyncStorage for offline

nodes.label: Progress Service
nodes.description: Tracks completed lectures (Set<lectureId>) via quiz_results table with FK auto-detection. Three-tier cache: module-level memCache → AsyncStorage → Supabase. Merges queued offline IDs. Provides optimisticallyMarkComplete for instant UI updates

nodes.label: Best Score Service
nodes.description: Tracks best quiz score per lecture (Map<lectureId, score%>) from quiz_results. Three-tier cache: memCache → AsyncStorage → Supabase. Merges queued offline scores. Provides optimisticallyUpdateBestScore for instant star updates

nodes.label: Question Service
nodes.description: Fetches quiz questions from Supabase 'questions' table with FK column auto-detection (tries lecture_id, subject_id, topic_id, etc.). Caches discovered FK column to AsyncStorage. Shuffles questions and options while tracking correct answer index

nodes.label: Stats Service
nodes.description: Aggregates quiz data into UserStats: total_quizzes, average_score, best_score, streak (with day-gap calculation), weekly_activity (Sat-Fri), subject_mastery, recent_results. Uses Supabase RPC get_user_stats_overview + user_stats table. Merges pending offline queue results. Caches to AsyncStorage + cacheStore

nodes.label: Question Cache
nodes.description: AsyncStorage-based per-lecture question cache (harvi:qcache:{lectureId}). Versioned (v3) to invalidate stale data. Used for offline quiz-taking after subject download. Tracks questionCount and downloadedAt for staleness detection

nodes.label: Offline Queue
nodes.description: Manages pending offline quiz result mutations (harvi:quiz_queue). Validated with Zod PendingQuizResultSchema. Generates UUIDs for deduplication. Provides enqueue, getQueue, removeSynced, clearQueueForUser, pendingCount

nodes.label: Supabase Client
nodes.description: createClient with custom SecureStoreAdapter that chunks auth tokens (1800-byte chunks) to work within iOS SecureStore 2KB limit. Falls back to localStorage on web. autoRefreshToken, persistSession enabled

nodes.label: Secure Store
nodes.description: Securely stores chunked auth session tokens. Custom adapter splits values >1800 bytes into __chunk_0, __chunk_1, etc. with a __count key

nodes.label: Async Storage
nodes.description: Persistent key-value storage used by: hierarchy cache, progress cache, best score cache, stats cache, access cache, purchases cache, offline queue, question cache, theme, profile (avatar/name), quiz FK column

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.description: Remote authentication provider supporting email/password and OAuth (Google). Provides JWT sessions with auto-refresh

nodes.label: Supabase Database
nodes.description: Tables: years, modules, subjects, lectures, questions, quiz_results, user_stats, purchases, feedback. RPCs: get_user_stats_overview, get_content_access_map, redeem_access_code

nodes.label: Edge Functions
nodes.description: Serverless backend: record-iap function verifies IAP transactions and grants access

nodes.label: RevenueCat
nodes.description: In-App Purchase SDK (react-native-purchases). Handles native Apple/Google payment flows, customer identity (logIn/logOut), purchase restoration, and receipt validation

nodes.label: NetInfo
nodes.description: Network connectivity detection. Used by syncStore (subscribe to changes), and by every service layer (fetch/addEventListener) for offline-first short-circuit before any Supabase call

nodes.label: Google OAuth
nodes.description: Google OAuth provider accessed via expo-web-browser openAuthSessionAsync. Supabase initiates the OAuth flow, browser handles consent, app receives code/tokens via deep link redirect

flows.name: App Startup
flows.description: Initialization sequence when the app launches: loads fonts, restores auth session, initializes theme and purchases, subscribes to network

steps.action: Loads Inter and Nunito fonts, prevents splash screen auto-hide
QueryClientProvider initialized with offlineFirst config
ThemeProvider loads saved theme from AsyncStorage
AuthProvider calls supabase.auth.getSession() and subscribes to onAuthStateChange
Reads chunked session tokens from SecureStore
Returns reassembled session JWT
PurchaseProvider initializes RevenueCat SDK and syncs user identity
SyncProvider subscribes to NetInfo, checks pending queue, auto-flushes if online
Hides splash screen once fonts loaded and auth resolved, renders Stack navigator

flows.name: Email Login
flows.description: Authenticates a user with email and password and establishes an application session

steps.action: User enters email and password on AuthScreen
useAuthForm calls signIn(email, password)
Calls supabase.auth.signInWithPassword
Validates credentials, returns JWT session
SecureStoreAdapter chunks and stores session tokens
onAuthStateChange fires, sets session/user state
useAuthForm calls router.replace('/(tabs)') on success

flows.name: Google OAuth Login
flows.description: Authenticates via Google OAuth using expo-web-browser and Supabase

steps.action: User taps 'Continue with Google' button
signInWithGoogle creates redirect URL via expo-linking
Calls supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth with Google provider
Opens browser session for Google consent (select_account)
Receives redirect URL, extracts code, calls exchangeCodeForSession
Exchanges authorization code for JWT session
Stores chunked session tokens
Navigates to main tabs on success

flows.name: Offline-First Content Browsing
flows.description: Loads the Year→Module→Subject→Lecture hierarchy, preferring cache when offline. Shows completion badges and best scores

steps.action: User opens Learn tab, useHierarchy triggers fetchHierarchy
Checks NetInfo connectivity
Returns connectivity state
If offline: returns AsyncStorage cache. If online: fetches from Supabase
Parallel SELECT * from years, modules, subjects, lectures
Returns all hierarchy data
Builds nested tree with FK auto-detection, caches to AsyncStorage
useProgress returns Set<lectureId> of completed lectures
useLectureBestScores returns Map<lectureId, score%>
useModuleAccess returns access map with paywall info
Renders year cards → module cards → subject cards → lecture cards with progress/score/lock indicators

flows.name: Online Quiz Taking
flows.description: User takes a quiz while online — saves result directly to Supabase, updates all caches optimistically

steps.action: User taps accessible lecture in SubjectScreen
QuizScreen mounts, useQuizSession initializes
Pre-loads questions from AsyncStorage cache (fast path)
useQuizQuestions fetches fresh questions from Supabase in background
SELECT * FROM questions WHERE lecture_id = ?
Auto-updates cache with fresh questions (fire-and-forget)
Locks in shuffled questions, user answers with haptic feedback
Last question answered — calculates score, generates UUID session ID
INSERT INTO quiz_results with 8s timeout
Saves quiz result
optimisticallyUpdateBestScore updates memCache + AsyncStorage
Invalidates progress, stats, lectureBestScores queries
Shows QuizResultsView with score ring animation

flows.name: Offline Quiz Taking
flows.description: User takes a quiz while offline — stores result locally for later sync

steps.action: User taps lecture (must be pre-downloaded for offline)
QuizScreen mounts, loads from question cache
Returns cached questions from AsyncStorage
User completes quiz offline
enqueueQuizResult writes to harvi:quiz_queue in AsyncStorage
Persists queue to disk
optimisticallyMarkComplete adds lectureId to memCache + AsyncStorage
optimisticallyUpdateBestScore updates score if higher

flows.name: User Sign-Up
flows.description: Creates a new account with email and password via Supabase Auth, stores session securely, and navigates to the main app

steps.action: User fills email and password fields, taps Sign Up
useAuthForm calls signUp(email, password)
Calls supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })
Creates user record, returns JWT session (or confirmation email if enabled)
SecureStoreAdapter chunks and persists session tokens
onAuthStateChange fires with SIGNED_IN event, sets session/user state
PurchaseProvider detects new user.id, calls Purchases.logIn(userId) to sync RevenueCat identity
router.replace('/(tabs)') navigates to main app

flows.name: User Sign-Out
flows.description: Signs the user out, clears all local caches and in-memory state, logs out of RevenueCat, and redirects to login

steps.action: User taps 'Sign Out' in AccountActions, haptic feedback fires
signOut() calls supabase.auth.signOut()
Revokes session on server, clears local auth tokens
SecureStoreAdapter removes all chunked session tokens
clearAll() resets statsCache, warmedStats, and questionCacheBypassed
memCache.clear() and warmed.clear() — wipes in-memory progress
memCache.clear() and warmed.clear() — wipes in-memory best scores
PurchaseProvider detects user=null, calls Purchases.logOut()
router.replace('/login') redirects to auth screen

flows.name: Offline Subject Download
flows.description: Downloads all questions for every lecture in a subject to AsyncStorage so the user can take quizzes offline

steps.action: User taps download button on SubjectScreen, useSubjectCache.downloadSubject() fires
NetInfo.fetch() verifies device is online; blocks with Alert if offline
Sets status='downloading', initializes progress counter { done: 0, total: lectures.length }
fetchQuestions(lectureId) called for each lecture sequentially
SELECT * FROM questions WHERE lecture_id = ? with FK auto-detection and 6s timeout
Returns question rows for each lecture
saveQuestionsToCache stores shuffled questions to AsyncStorage (harvi:qcache:{lectureId}) with v3 version and questionCount
Progress counter increments { done: i+1, total }, UI shows download progress bar
All lectures downloaded — loadState() re-evaluates cache status, sets status='downloaded'

flows.name: IAP Purchase Module
flows.description: User purchases a module via RevenueCat native IAP, records the transaction with the edge function, and unlocks content

steps.action: User taps a locked lecture in SubjectScreen, navigates to /purchase/[moduleId]
PurchaseScreen mounts, BuyTab displays RevenueCat packages with prices
purchaseModule(moduleId, rcPackage) called — initiates native payment
Purchases.purchasePackage triggers native Apple/Google payment sheet
Payment succeeds — extracts transactionIdentifier from receipt
supabase.functions.invoke('record-iap') with moduleId, transactionId, store (15s timeout)
record-iap validates receipt, inserts into purchases table, grants content access
invalidateAccess invalidates content_access, my_purchases, hierarchy, quiz queries
Shows SuccessState with confetti, user can navigate back to unlocked content

flows.name: Promo Code Redemption
flows.description: User redeems an access code to unlock a module without payment, via Supabase RPC

steps.action: User switches to CodeTab in PurchaseScreen, enters promo code
redeemCode(code) called with 15s timeout
Calls supabase.rpc('redeem_access_code', { p_code: code })
RPC validates code, marks it as used, creates purchase record, returns { success, item_name }
invalidateAccess invalidates content_access, my_purchases, hierarchy, quiz queries
Shows SuccessState with redeemed item name

flows.name: Restore Purchase
flows.description: User restores a previously purchased module from their Apple/Google account and re-records it with the backend

steps.action: User taps 'Restore Purchase' in PurchaseScreen
restoreModule(moduleId, productId) called
Purchases.restorePurchases() queries Apple/Google receipt store
Checks allPurchasedProductIdentifiers for matching productId
supabase.functions.invoke('record-iap') re-records the restored transaction
Validates and inserts purchase record (handles duplicate gracefully)
invalidateAccess refreshes content_access and my_purchases
Shows SuccessState — module is re-unlocked

flows.name: Offline Sync on Reconnection
flows.description: When the device comes back online, SyncProvider auto-flushes the offline queue to Supabase and updates all affected queries

steps.action: NetInfo.addEventListener fires with isConnected=true after network recovery
SyncProvider sets isOnline=true, calls onlineManager.setOnline(true)
useEffect detects isOnline && user — triggers flush()
getQueue() returns all PendingQuizResult[] from AsyncStorage
Filters queue for current user, iterates items with 10s timeout per insert
INSERT INTO quiz_results for each queued item (handles 23xxx duplicate codes)
Persists quiz results — duplicates silently accepted
removeSynced() clears successfully synced items from AsyncStorage
Invalidates stats and progress queries so UI reflects fresh server data
Sets isSyncing=false, updates pendingCount to remaining items

flows.name: Stats Dashboard Loading
flows.description: Loads the stats dashboard with multi-tier caching: synchronous cache → AsyncStorage → Supabase RPC, merging pending offline results

steps.action: User navigates to Stats tab, useStats hook triggers fetchStats
useStats reads statsCache for synchronous initialData (no loading spinner on revisit)
fetchStats checks NetInfo — if offline, serves from AsyncStorage cache
Returns connectivity state
Queries user_stats table + RPC get_user_stats_overview + lectures table for name map
Returns aggregated stats data
Reads pending queue to merge un-synced quiz results into displayed stats
Computes UserStats: streak, weekly_activity, subject_mastery, recent_results
writeCache sets stats in cacheStore.setStatsCache for instant access
Persists UserStats to harvi:stats:{userId} for offline fallback
Renders StreakCard, StatsMetricsGrid, WeeklyChart, MasterySection, RecentResultsSection

flows.name: Profile Editing
flows.description: User edits their avatar and display name on the EditProfileScreen, persisted to AsyncStorage

steps.action: User taps edit on ProfileScreen, navigates to EditProfileScreen
useProfileEdit loads current avatar (harvi:avatar) and displayName (harvi:displayName)
User taps avatar to open AvatarPicker — selects from DoctorAvatars grid
handleSelectAvatar immediately saves selected avatar ID to harvi:avatar
User edits display name text field
User taps Save — handleSave trims name, writes to AsyncStorage
Writes harvi:displayName and harvi:avatar
Success haptic notification fires, router.back() returns to ProfileScreen

flows.name: Theme Switching
flows.description: User switches between 'harvi' (warm beige) and 'pink' themes via ProfileThemeSelector

steps.action: User taps theme option in ProfileThemeSelector
setTheme updates Zustand state with new theme name
Persists theme choice to harvi:theme
ThemeProvider re-renders — all useColors consumers get new palette
Entire app re-renders with new color palette (Appearance.setColorScheme('light') for both)

flows.name: Feedback Submission
flows.description: User submits feedback from ProfileScreen, with connectivity check, input sanitization, character limit, and cooldown timer

steps.action: User scrolls to FeedbackForm on ProfileScreen, types feedback (max 500 chars)
useFeedback validates input: trims whitespace, sanitizes content, enforces character limit
NetInfo.fetch() checks connectivity — blocks submission if offline
INSERT INTO feedback with user_id and sanitized message
Saves feedback record

steps.action: User taps 'Clear Quiz History' in AccountActions, confirmation Alert shown
Checks isOnline — blocks with Alert if offline (requires network)
DELETE FROM quiz_results WHERE user_id = ? AND DELETE FROM user_stats WHERE user_id = ? (10s timeout)
Removes all quiz results and computed stats for this user
clearStatsCache wipes AsyncStorage and cacheStore for this user
clearProgressCache wipes memCache, warmed set, and AsyncStorage progress
clearBestScoreCache wipes memCache, warmed set, and AsyncStorage scores
clearQueueForUser removes any pending offline results for this user
setQueriesData zeroes stats/progress/bestScores immediately, then invalidateQueries refetches clean state
